selector.rationale: The presence of irregular red lacunae, irregular vessels, and absence of septa on dermoscopy, along with histopathological features of ectatic thin-walled vessels, intravascular branching papillary structures, and intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules, strongly support the diagnosis of Dabska tumor.
